explain_task.question: Using the revised model only, explain why the LP relaxation and final MIP both avoid Worker V, even though `x_V_D` has reduced cost 0 in the LP relaxation. Your answer must trace the logic from the business brief’s “one-time handling desk” gate to the exact code variables `pair_ii_v`, `y['V']`, `y['II']`, and the linearization constraints, and must cite the exact CSV field names and parameter values (`Fixed_Cost`, `worker_II_V_pair_fee`, `shared_temp_handoff_cost`). Also compare to the original model and identify the exact code additions that cause the objective to jump from 14.0 to 37.0, quantifying how much of the +23 comes from replacing Worker V with Worker I versus from newly introduced fixed/gate charges; include which LP constraints are binding/slack and why the shadow prices cannot be linearly extrapolated to “adding V back in.”
